verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close uses AI agents to review transactions and surface discrepancies during month-end close, which covers the core of an agent flagging issues before the close. The MCP server also exposes transactions and spending metrics, so an external agent can query the ledger. missing for 10: explicit duplicate-transaction detection, spend-anomaly flagging (beyond generic 'discrepancies'), continuous or scheduled ledger monitoring rather than a close-time run, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
Show me my top vendors by spend.
